Inventory icon (item-icons package): 128 px transparent WebP rendered from this row's own GLB by tools/icons/render_items.mjs (three.js in headless Chrome; same three-quarter camera, key/fill/rim lights, auto-fit margin and dark outline with a faint light edge for every icon). Original work. itemIconUrl returns /icons/items/<id>.webp (painted canvas kept as fallback, and for recoloured stacks); verified loaded at 128 px through itemIconUrl in the running game (all 116 rendered ids in one inventory), and seen in inventory/shop screenshots.
